content_descriptors.notes: The Warrens is a low-poly surreal horror game that features frequent but unrealistically presented gore and violence.  The main enemies in the game are cannibalistic and commit ritual suicide. They operate an industrial meat processing facility that uses captured, mutilated, people for labor.
